description_expanded: OverviewTop Reasons to Book this Fabulous Lakefront Retreat!* Directly on the Lake – Enjoy peaceful lakefront living in a beautiful Seacrest/Inlet Beach setting* Pet Friendly (add'l $200 fee)* Private Dock – Fish, relax, or launch kayaks, paddle boards, and the pedal boat right from the property* Paddle to the Beach – Kayak or paddle across the lake to a quiet beach access just 10–15 minutes away-2 Kayaks, 2 Paddle Boards and Pedal Boat Included* ½ Mile to Gulf Lakes Public Beach Access – Walk or bike to the beautiful sugar-white sand and emerald Gulf waters* 4 Complimentary Bikes * Beach Chairs, Umbrellas and Toys Included* Large Lakefront Deck and Balcony* Fire Pit – Gather under the stars and enjoy relaxing evenings together* 3 Minutes to The Big Chill * Can Be Rented with Bella Vista – Combine both units for larger groups, subject to availability*Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Please Note: Coastal Chateau is the upper floor of a two-level cottage and is one of two individual rental units. Your reservation is for Coastal Chateau only unless otherwise specified. The second unit may be occupied by other guests during your stay. The dock is shared when the units are rented separately. Coastal Chateau may be rented together with Bella Vista, subject to availability. Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.Welcome to Coastal Chateau, a peaceful lakefront retreat where the beauty of 30A meets the calm of Camp Creek Lake. This charming home offers the perfect setting for families and friends to slow down, reconnect, and enjoy everything the coast has to offer. Relax on the large deck overlooking the lake and gather around the fire pit. Spend the day fishing from the dock, paddling across the lake, biking along 30A, or enjoying a day on the Gulf. Inside, Coastal Chateau features three bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and sleeping accommodations for up to eight guests. The open and welcoming living spaces provide plenty of room to gather after a day in the sun, while large windows and the balcony bring the peaceful lake views indoors. The fully equipped kitchen makes it easy to prepare family meals, beach lunches, or a quick breakfast before heading out for the day. Come start making lasting memories at Coastal Chateau. The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedBedroom/Loft Space: Two Twin Trundle BedsArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
